skills.title: Extend missing GitHub operations through ephemeral Actions and API calls
skills.summary: When the connected GitHub tool lacks a repository operation, extend the reachable GitHub capability without polluting the main branch: prefer the native connector first, then use an ephemeral branch-scoped GitHub Actions workflow with least-privilege GITHUB_TOKEN permissions and gh api REST/GraphQL calls, make the operation idempotent where possible, verify the real remote effect, and remove or neutralize the helper branch/workflow afterward.
intents: perform a GitHub repository operation missing from the connected GitHub tool
extend GitHub automation with REST or GraphQL without adding permanent helper code to main
use a temporary GitHub Actions bridge for a repository-scoped API mutation

skills.title: Iterative Blender procedural asset generation with visual review
skills.summary: Build a Blender asset through bounded bpy iterations, emit durable standardized review renders, use semantic visual review to localize the next delta, rerun only the needed iteration, and promote one verified final render/script/blend set.
intents: refine a Blender model through rendered visual review
run a bounded AI-authored bpy generation loop
